title: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能

policy_extraction.issuing_body: 国家新一代人工智能治理专业委员会 (National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Governance Expert Committee)
covered_actors: 人工智能发展相关各方 (all parties related to AI development)
prohibited_practices: 滥用、恶用人工智能 (Abuse and malicious use of AI)
窃取、篡改、泄露和其他非法收集利用个人信息的行为 (Theft, tampering, leakage, and other illegal collection or use of personal information)

evidence.quote: 人工智能应用过程中应确保人类知情权，告知可能产生的风险和影响。
evidence.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence.quote_en: During the application of AI, the human right to know should be ensured, informing of potential risks and impacts.

evidence.quote: 人工智能发展应尊重和保护个人隐私，充分保障个人的知情权和选择权。
evidence.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence.quote_en: AI development should respect and protect personal privacy, and fully safeguard individuals' right to know and right to choose.

evidence.quote: 高度关注人工智能系统的安全，提高人工智能鲁棒性及抗干扰性，形成人工智能安全评估和管控能力。
evidence.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence.quote_en: Pay close attention to the safety of AI systems, improve AI robustness and anti-interference capability, and build AI safety assessment and management and control capabilities.

evidence.quote: 对未来更高级人工智能的潜在风险持续开展研究和预判，确保人工智能始终朝着有利于人类的方向发展。
evidence.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence.quote_en: Continuously conduct research and anticipation of the potential risks of more advanced AI in the future to ensure that AI always develops in a direction beneficial to humanity.

evidence.quote: 人工智能研发者、使用者及其他相关方应具有高度的社会责任感和自律意识，严格遵守法律法规、伦理道德和标准规范。
evidence.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence.quote_en: AI developers, users, and other relevant parties should have a high sense of social responsibility and self-discipline, and strictly abide by laws and regulations, ethics and morality, and standards and norms.

evidence.quote: 6月17日，国家新一代人工智能治理专业委员会发布《新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能》（以下简称《治理原则》），提出了人工智能治理的框架和行动指南。
evidence.source_section: 发展负责任的人工智能：新一代人工智能治理原则发布-中华人民共和国科学技术部
evidence.quote_en: On June 17, the National New Generation AI Governance Expert Committee released the "Governance Principles for the New Generation Artificial Intelligence — Developing Responsible Artificial Intelligence" (hereinafter referred to as the "Governance Principles"), proposing a framework and action guide for AI governance.

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Non-binding national AI governance principles framework issued by the National New Generation AI Governance Expert Committee (established by the New Generation AI Development Plan Promotion Office) and published via MOST. It articulates eight high-level ethical and governance principles—harmony and friendliness, fairness and justice, inclusivity and sharing, respect for privacy, security and controllability, shared responsibility, open collaboration, and agile governance—across the AI lifecycle, with no statutory enforcement authorities, compliance deadlines, or penalties.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The Principles frame AI governance primarily around innovation_enablement: the title, preamble, and Principle 8 ('Agile Governance') justify governance as a means to coordinate development with governance, respect AI development laws, and foster healthy, innovative, orderly, and internationally collaborative AI development. It edges out fundamental_rights (strongly represented in Principle 2 on fairness/non-discrimination and Principle 4 on privacy and informed choice) and social_stability (emphasized in Principle 1 on human-machine harmony, ethical values, social safety, and a shared future for humanity) because those principles are explicitly structured as pillars to enable 'developing responsible AI' rather than purely rights-restrictive or public-order mandates. Consumer_public_safety is a notable secondary frame via system safety, robustness, controllability, and misuse prevention, while economic_competitiveness (industrial upgrading, orderly competition) and existential_catastrophic (anticipating risks of future more advanced AI) receive minor mention.

evidence_spans.quote: 为促进新一代人工智能健康发展，更好协调发展与治理的关系，确保人工智能安全可靠可控，推动经济、社会及生态可持续发展，共建人类命运共同体
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence_spans.quote_en: To promote the healthy development of the new generation of artificial intelligence, better coordinate the relationship between development and governance, ensure that AI is safe, reliable, and controllable, promote sustainable economic, social, and ecological development, and jointly build a community with a shared future for humanity

evidence_spans.quote: 尊重人工智能发展规律，在推动人工智能创新发展、有序发展的同时，及时发现和解决可能引发的风险。
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence_spans.quote_en: Respect the laws of artificial intelligence development; while promoting the innovative and orderly development of artificial intelligence, timely discover and resolve potential risks.

evidence_spans.quote: 人工智能发展应促进公平公正，保障利益相关者的权益，促进机会均等。通过持续提高技术水平、改善管理方式，在数据获取、算法设计、技术开发、产品研发和应用过程中消除偏见和歧视。
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence_spans.quote_en: The development of AI should promote fairness and justice, protect the rights and interests of stakeholders, and promote equal opportunity. Through continuous improvement of technical standards and management methods, eliminate bias and discrimination in data acquisition, algorithm design, technology development, product R&D, and application.

evidence_spans.quote: 人工智能发展应尊重和保护个人隐私，充分保障个人的知情权和选择权。
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence_spans.quote_en: The development of AI should respect and protect personal privacy, and fully safeguard individuals' right to know and right to choose.

evidence_spans.quote: 人工智能发展应以增进人类共同福祉为目标；应符合人类的价值观和伦理道德，促进人机和谐，服务人类文明进步；应以保障社会安全、尊重人类权益为前提，避免误用，禁止滥用、恶用。
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence_spans.quote_en: The development of AI should aim to enhance the common well-being of humanity; conform to human values and ethics, promote human-machine harmony, and serve the progress of human civilization; take safeguarding social safety and respecting human rights and interests as prerequisites, avoid misuse, and prohibit abuse and malicious use.

evidence_spans.quote: 高度关注人工智能系统的安全，提高人工智能鲁棒性及抗干扰性，形成人工智能安全评估和管控能力。
evidence_spans.source_section: 新一代人工智能治理原则——发展负责任的人工智能
evidence_spans.quote_en: Pay high attention to the safety and security of AI systems, improve AI robustness and anti-interference capability, and establish AI safety assessment and control capabilities.
